mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a weakening labor market and slowing economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production, measured by a 1% y-o-y drop in the INDPRO index, signals supply constraints and slowing economic activity that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth falls by >1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% y-o-y, it signals a broad weakening in consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >5% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% y-o-y and the federal funds rate is below 3%, it signals an inflationary environment that will erode real equity returns and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Steadily declining unemployment, defined as a 0.5pp drop in UNRATE over 6 months, signals a tightening labor market and building inflationary pressures that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls > 0.5pp in 6 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) together signal a strengthening economy with healthy supply and demand conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rising and UNRATE falling y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.
